implementation: C61 working tree; committed with this study
scope: Original rstyle-core non-test library, explicit source/guard study policy unchanged from C60; full scope remains incomplete.

decode_comparison.method: Prebuilt debug census_replay_samples example; same new snapshot represented as raw4 shared census vs reconstructed raw3 inline census. Expanded wire uses the identical records and source table, replacing each reference with its prior definition. Three decodes per process, inline then shared; input read and census owner counting are outside decode timing. Peak RSS covers the whole probe process.
limitations: Single ordered pair of probe processes, no statistical or end-to-end speedup claim.
Fresh capture compared with C60 retains equal consumer results but differs in publication metadata; reconstructed inline payload isolates representation cost.
No source/evidence budgets, semantics, metric identities, strict matching or trust boundaries change.
Historical inline snapshots are decoded as recorded; separate census owners are not merged by equality or rescanned.
